text: The Ice Statue in Noeliel Castle

Go to Noeliel Castle to help Agios and Nicola amplify
Xmas energy!

You can go to Noeliel Castle from Navida City: Crossroad.

To create the ice statue of Noeliel the great spirit,
which is needed to amplify Xmas energy in Navida City,
go collect [ffff64]Sacred Snow[ffffff]!

You can collect [Sacred Snow] at [ffff64]Noeliel Castle: 2F[ffffff].
Drive off anti Xmas energy without breaking the ice statue!
